title: One-step window growth
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on $x$. If every work-tape head of $C$ lies within distance $s$ of the origin and every work-tape cell outside that range is blank, then after one step using either choice bit, every head lies within distance $s+1$ and every cell outside that range is blank.
